visitors.hello: Sniff sniff... is that YOUR farm I smell? Lovely!
visitors.name: Bramble the Badger
quirks: Once ate a whole order before paying. Paid double.
visitors.tagline: Runs the jam stand down the lane.

visitors.hello: Saw your farm from the clouds! I want the shiniest bits.
visitors.name: Wren the Sparrow
quirks: Collects shiny things. Your plants qualify.

visitors.hello: No rush, young farmer. Good things grow slowly. ...Slightly impatiently.
visitors.name: Moss the Tortoise
quirks: Pays the best rates in the valley.
visitors.tagline: Old, slow, and your richest customer.
